zh-CN.title: 广场拥有全新的发布体验
items: 浏览与发布分离，信息流更加轻盈清晰
发言、可见范围、照片位置与录音拥有专属交互
照片和语音卡片重新设计，移动端与桌面端同步适配

en.title: A redesigned publishing experience for the Square
items: Browsing and composing are separated for a cleaner feed
Statements, audience, photo location, and voice recording now have focused interactions
Photo and voice cards are redesigned across mobile and desktop
